notes: This is al-Faqih's statement of his routes («فقد رويته عن ...») to Abu Hammam, with no saying: needs_ruling by rule 11.

«جميعا عن أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى» makes Ahmad the shared level of the first two routes; «و إبراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن أبي همام» is a separate route. The text does not name a link after Ahmad or Ibrahim, so none is added.
«أبي» (occurrence 2) is the compiler's father, named only by relation; occurrence 1 is in «عن أبي همّام».
